## 2024-05-24 - [Vue 3 Large List Re-render Optimization]
**Learning:** [In Vue 3, hovering over a single element in a large dynamically rendered list (like cards generated by `v-for`) can trigger O(N) full list re-renders if reactive tracking is not specifically optimized for the element state.]
**Action:** [Use the `v-memo` directive explicitly mapping primitive dependencies (e.g. `item.id, item.status, isHovered`) to prevent Vue from executing unnecessary virtual DOM diffing for unchanging siblings.]
